description: Source code implementing a client adapter for Kubernetes feature gates, providing methods to enable features, add features with versioning, and set feature states for testing.

classes.name: clientAdapter
classes.description: Adapter struct that bridges a MutableFeatureGate to client-go's feature interface.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Checks if a feature is enabled.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds new features to the feature gate.

methods.name: AddVersioned
methods.description: Adds versioned features to the feature gate.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the enabled/disabled state of a feature for testing.
